S.FORM: == Sahosyo rikec to Taywan == "2020 miheca Sahosyo rikec to Taywan" (Inkiris: Taiwan Assurance Act of 2020), o cecay sarekec no Amilika. Saki "2021 miheca patatekoan pafeli to payso a telek" i saka FF to saka Ⅲ cecfang no B siikedan no pangangan. Likisi 'Alodo no pitelek "2019 miheca Sahosyo rikec to Taywan" i 2019 miheca 3 folad 26 romi'ad ato 4 folad 1 romi'ad masilsil i Fafa'eday pikaykian ato Kararemay pikaykian no Amilika nai ci Tom Cotton ato ci Mike McCall ko pasadakay. Ikor a mirina'an nai 2019 miheca 5 folad 7 romi'ad maemin mihayda ko Kararemay pikaykian no Amilika . I 2020 miheca 12 folad 21 romi'ad, o lawot no rikec mapacomod i "2021 miheca patatekoan pafeli to payso a telek" i saka FF to saka Ⅲ cecfang no B siikedan no pangangan, toya romi'ad mihayda ko kafa'eday pikaykian ato Kararemay pikaykian, onini a roma sowal "2020 miheca Sahosyo rikec to Taywan" sanay . I 12 folad 27 romi'ad, nai ci Donald Trumpan mipangangan a malaheci . Pisalof to rikec I 2023 miheca 3 folad 22 romi'ad o kafa'eday pikaykian ira ko 404 paya ko micokeray, 7 ko miliyangay, mahayda konini a rikec to "Sahosyo rikec to Taywan sademak" (Taiwan Assurance Implementation Act), masahacecay to liyad misalof, milongoc to citodongay to rikec ato patomadaway to Kakiharan rikec no Taywan paromi'ad mitomadaw kasa 2 miheca mifalic to paratoh, palekapoten i "Pato'ek ato halaka, palasawad to mitolasay to saki Kakiharan rikec no Taywan" a tilidan . 2025 miheca 5 folad 5 romi'ad mihayda i ngoyosan ko kafa'eday pikaykian no Amilika, mihayda tonini nisalofan a rikec to "Sahosyo rikec to Taywan sademak" (Taiwan Assurance Implementation Act H.R. 1512), o nihaydaan i 2020 miheca a "Sahosyo rikec to Taywan sademak 2020" (Taiwan Assurance Act of 2020) a pa'icelan a tilid . "Sahosyo rikec to Taywan sademak" milongoc to citodongay to rikec kitakit no Amilika paromi'ad mikinsa to pakayniay to kakiharan to Taywan a kacacawma' a saleko, halo maanan kadadoedo todong no tilid. Salongan kasa 5 miheca kinacecay mitomadaw, i salaloma'an no 90 romi'ad patayraen i laocan pikaykian no kitakit pasadak to piratoh . Kasaliyad tilid Salaloma'an no sarikec sapicoker to kalali'aca to sakalalood no sofitay o kararidan padama to sakacowat no Taywan a sa'icel a satena', micoker to Taywan citodong sapikihatiya to sakapot no kasakitakit, milongoc to citodongay to rikec no kitakit patodong mitomadaw sakihar to Taywan "Saki Taywan kacacawma' a saleko" a tilid to sapitomadaw a masafa'eloh ko saleko, saki "Pirarakat rikec to Taywan" sapidemak ato sakaciroma no sademak pasadak a ratoh. "Sahosyo rikec to Taywan sademak". "Sahosyo rikec to Taywan sademak 2020" salofan: milongoc to citodongay to rikec no Amilika to "sakayat kakiharan to Taywan" sapiparomi'ad mitomadaw ato misafa'eloh to ratoh. Nai Kararemay pikaykian ato Fafa'eday pikaykian kalacecayan mitelek Amilika kitakit: Saka 1 liyad, Mamoko'ay sowal. Onini a rikec O "Sahosyo rikec to Taywan sademak" (Taiwan Assurance Implementation Act). Saka 2 liyad, Patongal no citodongay to rikec i sakayat to kakiharan to Taywan a todong ratoh. "Sahosyo rikec to Taywan sademak 2020" saka 315 liyad (kapolongan rikec saka 116 - 260 haw saka FF felih saka III cefang B siikedan no pangangan; 134Stat. 3100) falican i laeno: (1) I saka hecek saka (1) paring, nai "memorandum" a sowal pacomod: "paikor to tilid, ano eca maanan to halo sakayat kakiharan to Taywan a todong no tilid". (2) Satelocan no tilid parafas to fa'elohay saka hecek: Paromi'ad mitomadaw ato safa'eloh parotoh. (1) Saan a setekan. Nai citodongay no kitakit padoedo to maanan sakowan ato sakayat to kakiharan to Taywan (tinako saka hecek a paini) a saanan, o citodongay no kitakit o: Salongan 5 miheca, pasi citodongay no kitakit to sakayat to kakiharan to Taywan ko mitomadaway, halo ngangan "to sakayat to kakiharan to Taywan" (Guidelines on Relations with Taiwan) romi'adan patilidan ato satodongan no tilid, miliyaw miratoh to sakayat no midemakay a citodongay; ato Kalahecian i saka (1) a paring setek a mitomadaw i 'ayaw no 90 romi'ad i, pasi Fafa'eday pikaykian kacacofelan a demak iingkay ato Kararemay pikaykian kacacofelan a cidemakay iingkay a pasadak to fa'elohay ratoh. (2) Laloma'an no ratoh. Midotoc saka (1) a paring ko pilongoc misafa'eloh paratoh halo: saka hecek nilongocan a polong no saratoh; ato saheci to pisafa'eloh a sacayat samaanen milaheci saka hecek nisowalan to pato'ekan a patosokan. "Sahosyo rikec to Taywan sademak 2020" saka 315 liyad (kapolongan rikec saka 116 - 260 haw saka FF felih saka III cefang B siikedan no pangangan; 134Stat. 3100) falican i laeno: (1) I saka hecek saka (1) paring, nai "memorandum" a sowal pacomod: "paikor to tilid, ano eca maanan to halo sakayat kakiharan to Taywan a todong no tilid". (2) Satelocan no tilid parafas to fa'elohay saka hecek: Paromi'ad mitomadaw ato safa'eloh parotoh. (1) Saan a setekan. Nai citodongay no kitakit padoedo to maanan sakowan ato sakayat to kakiharan to Taywan (tinako saka hecek a paini) a saanan, o citodongay no kitakit o: Salongan 5 miheca, pasi citodongay no kitakit to sakayat to kakiharan to Taywan ko mitomadaway, halo ngangan "to sakayat to kakiharan to Taywan" (Guidelines on Relations with Taiwan) romi'adan patilidan ato satodongan no tilid, miliyaw miratoh to sakayat no midemakay a citodongay; ato Kalahecian i saka (1) a paring setek a mitomadaw i 'ayaw no 90 romi'ad i, pasi Fafa'eday pikaykian kacacofelan a demak iingkay ato Kararemay pikaykian kacacofelan a cidemakay iingkay a pasadak to fa'elohay ratoh. (2) Laloma'an no ratoh. Midotoc saka (1) a paring ko pilongoc misafa'eloh paratoh halo: saka hecek nilongocan a polong no saratoh; ato saheci to pisafa'eloh a sacayat samaanen milaheci saka hecek nisowalan to pato'ekan a patosokan.
